stem.text: Which circuit results in output voltage $V_\text{out}$ increasing with increasing temperature?

A.alt: Circuit diagram: a cell, a fixed resistor and a thermistor in series. Output terminals labelled Vout are connected across both components.

B.alt: Circuit diagram: a cell, a fixed resistor and a thermistor in series. Output terminals labelled Vout are connected across the thermistor.

C.alt: Circuit diagram: a cell, a fixed resistor and a thermistor in series. Output terminals labelled Vout are connected across the upper resistor.

D.alt: Circuit diagram: a cell and two fixed resistors in series. Output terminals labelled Vout are connected across the upper resistor.
